# Research contract fixtures

Copied verbatim from the Builder schema directory for S010a tests: common,
experiment-config, study-manifest and evidence-export under v1; S010b adds
study-annotations and study-analysis, also copied verbatim. These are test
data, not an alternate schema authority. Runtime code accepts an operator-selected
schema directory; each export bundles those schemas for portable verification.
When the authoritative contracts change, recopy these files and validate the
matching Builder examples. The seven runtime schemas in world fixtures remain
unchanged.
